answer: Verification bounds each agent by graph centrality on the attestation graph: an honest agent keeps degree centrality under 0.02 across 50 distinct peers per epoch, with a 120 POA bond per identity. One honest agent holds 1 node and 1 edge set; 10 fakes must fabricate 10 disjoint neighbourhoods and 10 centrality histories, multiplying coordination cost tenfold. Peers recompute centrality from public edges, slash the bond and freeze Sybil clusters, binding walnut, jetty and saffron to each attested step.
